candidate.user_submission: This child is 18 months old. The child has fever and the temperature is 38.0°C. The fever has lasted for 2 days. The child is not convulsing now and has not had convulsions. The child is not lethargic or unconscious. The child is able to drink or breastfeed. The child does not vomit everything. There is no generalized rash. There is no identified bacterial cause of fever in this assessment. This is a high malaria risk area, but malaria test is not available. There is no cough with measles and no measles within the last 3 months. There is no obvious cause of fever seen. The child does not have red eyes or runny nose. There is no stiff neck. The child does not have cough or difficult breathing. The child does not have diarrhoea. The child does not have any ear problem.
